entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Project load error when changing include reference to same file via different path #84854
  • Add tag for diagnostics that need to be suppressed with `[UnconditionalSuppressMessage]`. #84848
  • VS creates error bar on property rename complaining about GetRequiredDocument #84847
  • [Known Build Error] System.Threading.Tasks.TaskCanceledException #84846

Closed

  • Finalize new public APIs shape for Unions feature and remove experimental marker from them #82567
    .NET 11
  • Collection Expression Arguments public API #82210
    .NET 11
  • Labeled break/continue public API #83266
    .NET 11

PullRequests

Created

  • enable network isolation for pr val #84853
  • Fix/84847 source generated rename conflict #84849
    Community, VSCode
  • Re-land the sonic decl/impl split with fallback discovery parse reuse #84844
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Support editorconfig for Razor in formatting, code actions, etc #84843
    Area-Razor
  • Redo of Use local C# formatting options in Razor cohosting #84842
    Area-Razor
  • Add a timeout to Razor component rename #84840
    Area-Razor
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #84835
  • Fix/enable navigating to SourceLink from Razor #84834
    Area-Razor

Merged

  • Add C# 15 language version #84799
    Needs API Review, VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Prevent tool install from using nuget.org #84852
  • Unsafe evolution: allow await in unsafe context #84616
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Fix empty localization stage on non-main/release branches in official pipeline #84845
  • Reorder stages for localization and build #84841
  • Revert the sonic decl/impl split merge from main #84831
    VSCode, Area-Razor

Updated

  • Add on-demand project loading #84591
    VSCode
  • Migrate Csc to multithreaded MSBuild execution #84701
    Needs API Review, VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Delete random bits of unused Razor code #84804
    Area-Razor
  • ShadowCopyAnalyzerPathResolver: Use cache to amortize cost of AV scans #84765
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Use helix job monitor #84810
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Support loading cached project data from .lscache files #84790
    VSCode
  • Add opt-in ~/ asset-path expansion for Razor components (compiler) #84796
    Area-Razor
  • Add compiler telemetry #84725
    Area-Compilers
  • Revert "Use SQLite3MC (#84140)" and update SourceGear.Sqlite3 to 3.53.4 #84692
    Area-Infrastructure, Community
  • Migrate MapSourceRoots task to multithreaded mode #84421
    Community
  • Migrate CopyRefAssembly to multithreaded execution model #84420
    Community
  • Migrate GenerateMSBuildEditorConfig task to multithreaded mode #84419
    Community
  • Unsafe evolution: symbol display #84706
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Preserve indentation in XML doc comment CDATA sections #84750
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #83901
    Area-Infrastructure, Needs API Review
